licence.scope: PROBA2 Science Center (Royal Observatory of Belgium) terms of use (level 2, owner's data terms) for LYRA/SWAP data; does not name the filter curves explicitly. Source cited by SVO: Mironov et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ASPC..503..123M). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
